ASSIGNMENT.TITLE: Assignment
ASSIGNMENT.INTRO_ADMIN: Decide who owns each control and which delegate of their team helps run it. A new control arrives with no owner.
ASSIGNMENT.INTRO_OWNER: Delegate the controls you own to the delegates of your team. The owner stays responsible for the control even if someone else runs it.
ASSIGNMENT.LOAD_ERROR_TITLE: We could not load the assignment
ASSIGNMENT.NO_SERVICES_BODY_ADMIN: Controls are assigned per service. Create a service and its controls will show up here, with no owner.
ASSIGNMENT.NO_SERVICES_BODY_OWNER: There are no services with controls in your charge yet. The administrator will assign you the controls that will be yours.
ASSIGNMENT.TEAM_LOAD_ERROR: We could not load your team, and it is needed to assign.
ASSIGNMENT.SEARCH: Search by control code, requirement (CC6.1) or name

TABLE.CAPTION: Controls of the service with their owner, executor and status
TABLE.NAME: Name

OWNER.UNASSIGNED_HINT: Nobody is responsible for this control yet. Give it an owner so they get the notification and can manage it.
OWNER.TITLE: Assign owner
OWNER.SUBTITLE: The owner is responsible for the selected controls and approves their evidence. It can be a responsible person or yourself.
OWNER.LABEL: Owner
OWNER.HINT: When the owner changes, the delegate who ran the control is removed. We notify the assigned person.
OWNER.NO_CANDIDATES: There are no active responsible people. Create one in Team or assign the controls to yourself.

EXECUTOR.NEEDS_OWNER: No owner: nobody runs it yet

DELEGATE.TITLE: Delegate
DELEGATE.SUBTITLE: The delegate uploads the evidence of the selected controls; the owner stays responsible for them.
DELEGATE.LABEL: Delegate
DELEGATE.HINT: You can only choose delegates from the team of the control's owner. We notify the assigned person.
DELEGATE.NO_TEAM: {{owner}} has no delegates in their team. Invite one in Team, or remove the delegate so the owner runs it.
DELEGATE.REASON_NO_OWNER: One of the selected controls has no owner, and a control with no owner cannot have a delegate.
DELEGATE.REASON_MIXED_OWNERS: The selected controls belong to different owners, and each delegate belongs to the team of a single owner.
DELEGATE.REMOVE_ONLY: For now you can only remove the delegate. To assign one, select controls of the same owner.

SELECTION.NONE: Select one or more controls to assign their owner or delegate them.
SELECTION.LIMIT: An assignment takes up to 200 controls.

STATE_HINT.EFFECTIVE: The control's tests pass and its evidence is current.
STATE_HINT.INEFFECTIVE: A test of the control fails: check what is missing and who fixes it.
STATE_HINT.EXPIRED: The control's evidence expired: new evidence has to be uploaded.
STATE_HINT.ERROR: We could not evaluate the control. Try again later.
STATE_HINT.INCOMPLETE: The control is missing evidence or one of its tests.
STATE_HINT.NO_TESTS: The control has no tests that evaluate it yet.

EMPTY.ALL_ASSIGNED_TITLE: Every control already has an owner
EMPTY.ALL_ASSIGNED_BODY: No control is left unassigned in this service. Remove the filter to see how they are distributed.
EMPTY.FILTERED_BODY: Try another search or remove the filters to see all the controls of the service.
EMPTY.NONE_ADMIN_BODY: Controls show up when the service finishes getting ready. If it has been a while, try again later.
EMPTY.NONE_OWNER_TITLE: You have no controls in your charge in this service
EMPTY.NONE_OWNER_BODY: When the administrator assigns you controls of this service, you will be able to delegate them here.

TOAST.OWNER_SET_BODY: We notified the new owner. Previous delegates were removed.
TOAST.OWNER_CLEARED_ONE: 1 control is now without an owner
TOAST.OWNER_CLEARED_MANY: {{count}} controls are now without an owner
TOAST.OWNER_CLEARED_BODY: Without an owner nobody is responsible for them: assign one soon.
TOAST.NOTHING_CHANGED_BODY: The selected controls were already like that.

ERROR.GENERIC: We could not save the assignment. Try again in a few minutes.
ERROR.OWNER_NOT_ELIGIBLE: That person can no longer be an owner: their account changed. Choose someone else.
ERROR.EXECUTOR_NOT_IN_TEAM: That delegate is not in the team of the control's owner. Choose someone from their team.
ERROR.CONTROL_RETIRED: One of the controls was retired and can no longer be assigned. We refreshed the list: choose again.
ERROR.BATCH_SIZE: An assignment takes between 1 and 200 controls.
